title: KeyRevocationSignal
description: Category C — operational projection of the imagodei KeyRevocation DHT entry becoming effective. Source-of-truth is the DHT-notarized KeyRevocation entry referenced by actionHash (imagodei DNA). The stream message is reconstructable from the DNA. Emitted when a revocation reaches quorum and transitions to effective state (Recovery M4 RecoveryV2Signal::KeyRevocationEffective). The controller sweep in Task A.8 uses compromiseAt to retroactively invalidate EPR attestations signed between compromiseAt and effectiveAt.

actionHash.description: Holochain ActionHash (base64) of the KeyRevocation DHT entry that became effective. Use to verify provenance against the DHT.

agentCid.description: CID of the agent whose key was revoked.

revokedPubkey.description: The revoked ed25519 pubkey (base64, 32 bytes). Any EPR attestations bearing this pubkey that were issued after compromiseAt must be considered invalid.

compromiseAt.description: Point in time the key is declared to have first been compromised. The controller sweep (Task A.8) uses this as the retroactive invalidation boundary: EPR verifications referencing this key issued AFTER this timestamp are tainted.

effectiveAt.description: Point at which the revocation became effective in the DHT (when vote quorum was reached). Corresponds to KeyRevocationEffective.effective_at from Recovery M4.

triggeringRevocationId.description: ID linking back to the KeyRevocation request that drove this effective event. Null if the revocation was administrative (no vote chain). Corresponds to M4 KeyRevocationEffective.triggering_vote_id.

emittedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the signal was emitted from the conductor post-commit hook.
